newsitem.title: USA: Toro Corp sets $175 mln in two-part debt.
newsitem.headline: Toro Corp sets $175 mln in two-part debt.

text.p: The following $175 million two-part debt offering from The Toro Corp was priced on Wednesday in the corporate bond market. The deal was underwritten by Goldman Sachs & Co.
